excerpt: Your gold lifted growth in 2025 and turned your current account to surplus.
paras: Your gold lifted growth in 2025 and turned your current account to surplus. Most of you live from the land, and four in ten are under fifteen. The task is to bank the gold into farms, schools and power that last beyond the price of gold.

Your partners are working beside you. In March 2026 the World Bank approved $215.9 million to transform your agriculture, and in July $120 million more for economic opportunity and resilience. Your schools and clinics carry World Bank financing approved in 2025: $140 million for education and €142 million for health. At home, your Diaspora Bonds raised 151.5 billion CFA francs in 2026, against a target of 125 billion.

The work ahead is plain, and it is worth saying plainly. Eighty-eight in every hundred of your city dwellers live in slums. Each of you uses about 135 kilowatt hours of electricity a year, about a seventh of what a decent life needs, and fewer than one in five cooks with clean fuel. At the last count, in 2019, seventy-four in every hundred of your children reached the end of primary school unable to read a simple text. Shelter sets your Coverage today, at 12.1 out of 100, with power and reading close behind. Each of them is within your reach.

Now imagine that same resolve turned toward every home in the country. Picture Perfect Burkina Faso: a morning when every family cooks with clean fuel and sits down to a full table; when every tap runs clean and every home has a safe toilet; when every child walks to a school where a teacher is waiting, and reads with ease by the age of ten; when every mother lives within reach of a clinic with the lights on, and every young person finds work that pays. And no Burkinabè falls below a decent life, because the nation has decided that none will.
quote: Gold is a season. Farms, schools and power are a century. Let the season pay for the century.
